stage: Descriptive degradation-mode diagnostics, even after stage4 exit
main: All32 anchor-cell fits retained, no predictor selection
mode_intervals: LLI from stage3 fixed-QLi profiles. Add fixed-Qn and fixed-Qp nuisance-refit profiles with the same main loss and n_eff. Use97.5% component intervals for reference/current subtraction (Bonferroni nominal95 per difference); reference anchor0 modes are zero by definition. Mark prior boundaries and unavailable intervals; all outputs inherit stage3 unidentified status.
additional_grids: Qn/Qp60..200 step10 plus fitted center and center plus/minus.25,.5,1,2,4,8,16,32,64 within bounds
profile_starts: frozen main optimum and previous profile solution; same bounded soft-L1 solver. Cache includes input, sources, fixed values and actual starts.
limiting_cells: CK1..7 use only last visible anchor(k-1). CK0 is the prescribed heldout calibration, not an online prediction. Report minimum-voltage cell at first pack11.2V root; separately per-cell2.8V first/second crossings and stoichiometric end gaps. Single-cell crossing never replaces pack cutoff.
LLI_share: Report nominal model-LLI / observed anchor-Qfc loss as an explicitly unvalidated comparison to empirical68–79%; model total-capacity share unavailable if reference chain has no valid root. No hidden-label claims.
recovery_coverage: Audit first periodic CV charge after each anchor using integrated actual current/time and depth coverage. Fit recovery only if its window reaches the graphite-step/lower-plateau region (>=45Ah); otherwise mark not identifiable and do not fit.
artifacts: per-cell mode table with nominal95 ranges and status
exposure: exposed-exploratory; allmode values are diagnostics, not validated electrode inventories.
